descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S19 「现成的 spec：删病历这件事本身会写进审计日志」 Existing spec: deleting a chart is itself written to the audit log

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T2 Deleting a patient removes all of that patient's data immediately (hard delete, not hidden); the audit log of who accessed the chart is kept.（TFA-92579 AC 2；UAT TC-24）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given A Hospital chart created and updated through the API

When rounding:remove

Then An audit row naming the chart id exists after the delete

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright api assertions. Covers 'the delete is logged' only; 'earlier PHI_READ rows survive the delete', 'no child rows left', and Nursing Home are S20

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

  • api/audit.spec.ts [api] — updating and deleting a chart are both recorded — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api spec): it creates the chart and reads audit_logs with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
